what_is_closed: the Hanfland et al. primary equation-of-state PDF is archived with a reproducible hash
the room-temperature graphite pressure-volume EOS row is transcribed with its source locator and uncertainty
the source definition is an isothermal bulk-modulus derivative at T=300 K
the scalar K_T source record has explicit material, pressure, temperature, units, uncertainty, and preprocessing boundaries
major_result.equation_or_mapping: K_T(T0,P0) = -V*(partial P/partial V)_T = dP/d(-ln V); source Murnaghan fit at T0=300 K, P0=0 gives K_T=33.8 +/- 3.0 GPa
major_result.derivation_class: source transcription of a fixed-temperature XRD equation-of-state fit; no local refit and no UET derivation
major_result.observable: ambient-pressure room-temperature graphite isothermal bulk modulus
major_result.dependency_unlocked: declared 300 K natural-graphite isothermal K_T source lane only; no same-grade Cp-to-Cv, alpha_Phi_K, transport, Core, Gravity, or Galaxy unlock
major_result.claim_boundary: This is a source-traceable 300 K natural-graphite isothermal bulk-modulus input. It is not a Ding TTG material match, not a full Cp-to-Cv closure, not UET transport, and not an alpha_Phi_K calibration.

source.title: Graphite under pressure: Equation of state and first-order Raman modes
source_locators: PDF p. 1 / printed p. 12598: measurements at T=300 K and powder X-ray diffraction method
PDF p. 2 / printed p. 12599: powder sample preparation and fixed-temperature lattice-parameter EOS fit
PDF p. 3 / printed p. 12600 / Fig. 2 paragraph: V0=35.12(2) Angstrom^3 per unit cell and B0=33.8(30) GPa
source.material: natural graphite powder prepared by grinding natural graphite flakes
source.pressure_scope: ambient-pressure intercept of a 300 K pressure-volume EOS
source.measurement_method: diamond-anvil-cell powder X-ray diffraction with a methanol-ethanol pressure medium; Murnaghan least-squares EOS fit
source_limitations: the source provides a scalar EOS fit rather than a machine-readable pressure-volume table in this archive
the sample is natural graphite powder and is not demonstrated to be the Ding TTG HOPG sample
the source is a 300 K scalar anchor, not a temperature-resolved K_T series

source_row.row_identity: reported Murnaghan EOS fit at ambient pressure, fixed T=300 K
source_row.preprocessing: byte-preserving PDF archive; scalar transcription from the EOS paragraph; no figure digitization, interpolation, refit, target access, or uncertainty rescaling

claim_boundary: The package supplies a source-locked 300 K graphite K_T scalar anchor. It does not close same-grade alpha_V/density, Ding PBTE C_src(T), base Phi-to-energy mapping, alpha_Phi_K, transport, SK/KMS, entropy, external validation, or global UET closure.
